items.headline: Burrow throws 4 TD passes as Bengals storm past Jackson-less Ravens in 2nd half of 35-13 win
items.description: — Joe Burrow threw four touchdown passes in the second half, and the Cincinnati Bengals rebounded from a desultory first two quarters to beat Baltimore 35-13 on Sunday, handing the Ravens a second straight divisional loss with Lamar Jackson sidelined.
